products.name: Royal Lakshmi Matte Finish 1-Gram Gold Choker Set
products.description: Exquisite handcrafted South Indian choker necklace featuring Goddess Lakshmi motifs, fine ruby and emerald kemp stone embellishments, and dangling South Sea pearls. Finished with durable 1-gram gold-finish electroplating.
products.short_description: Traditional Lakshmi motif choker with earrings in high-grade 1-gram gold finish.
products.materials_and_finish: High-durability brass copper alloy with 24k micron 1-gram gold-tone electroplate.
products.genuine_gold_disclaimer: This is a premium imitation 1-gram gold-finish fashion piece and contains no precious gold metal or BIS hallmark certification.
products.care_instructions: Store in the supplied air-tight velvet pouch. Avoid direct contact with deodorant, perfumes, soap water, and sweat.

products.name: Heritage Peacock Filigree Antique Jhumkas
products.description: Grand two-tier temple jhumkas inspired by regal royal court treasures. Adorned with delicate peacock carvings, micro pearls, and lightweight hollow dome craft for comfortable all-day wear.
products.short_description: Antique gold finish lightweight heritage peacock dome jhumkas.
products.materials_and_finish: Skin-friendly lead-free brass with antique gold matte polish.
products.genuine_gold_disclaimer: This is high-finish fashion costume jewellery and contains no genuine precious metals.
products.care_instructions: Wipe gently with a soft cotton cloth after wearing before storing.

products.name: Classic Micro-Plated Gold Kada Bangles (Set of 2)
products.description: Stunning pair of screw-openable kada bangles finished with a radiant 1-gram gold look. Subtle floral engraving provides timeless sophistication for weddings, festivals, and pujas.
products.short_description: Set of 2 screw-openable floral kada bangles with 1-gram gold tone.
products.materials_and_finish: Non-tarnish brass core with double-coated micro gold plating.
products.genuine_gold_disclaimer: Fashion imitation jewellery item without real gold bullion content.
products.care_instructions: Keep away from perfumes and hand sanitizers. Do not immerse in water.

products.name: Navratna Multistrand Bridal Haar & Pendant Set
products.description: Grand 9-gem replica Navratna long necklace (Haaram) with detailed gold filigree mesh beads and matching stud earrings. Ideal centerpiece for bridal sarees and festive lehengas.
products.short_description: Grand multi-stone Navratna long haaram with matching earrings.
products.materials_and_finish: Copper brass alloy with micro gold rhodium coating and synthetic faceted navratna stones.
products.genuine_gold_disclaimer: This is premium synthetic/fashion imitation jewellery with gold finish.
products.care_instructions: Store in velvet lined box. Polish gently with a dry lint-free cloth.

products.name: Luxury French Matte Pastel Hair Claw Clip (Pack of 3)
products.description: Set of 3 heavy-duty non-slip French claw clips in stylish muted tones (Navy Blue, Cream White, and Blush Rose). Engineered with durable rust-free steel springs to firmly hold thick and fine hair comfortably.
products.short_description: Pack of 3 aesthetic matte finish sturdy claw clips.
products.materials_and_finish: Shatterproof acrylic resin with soft rubberized matte coating.
products.care_instructions: Clean with damp cloth. Store dry.

products.name: Pure Mulberry Silk Hair Scrunchies (Pack of 4)
products.description: Zero-frizz, anti-breakage 100% grade 6A silk hair ties. Protects your hair follicles from split ends and crease lines while adding understated elegance to your wrist or ponytail.
products.short_description: Pack of 4 pure silk scrunchies in Royal Navy, Champagne Gold, Pearl White & Rose.
products.materials_and_finish: 100% Mulberry Silk with flexible high-rebound elastic.
products.care_instructions: Hand wash with cold water and mild silk shampoo. Air dry in shade.

products.name: Traditional Temple Kundan Bridal Waist Belt (Vaddanam)
products.description: Royal south-Indian bridal Kamarbandh / Vaddanam featuring embossed Peacock & Lakshmi carving with hanging gold bead ghungroos. Adjustable chain link fits waist sizes 26 to 40 inches.
products.short_description: Antique gold finish bridal waistbelt (Vaddanam) with kundan work.
products.materials_and_finish: Sturdy zinc brass alloy with matte 1-gram gold tone and synthetic kundan stones.
products.genuine_gold_disclaimer: This is traditional bridal imitation jewellery and contains no genuine gold.
products.care_instructions: Keep wrapped in plastic or soft cloth when not in use.

products.name: Handmade Pearl & Crystal Bridal Hair Pins (Set of 6)
products.description: Handmade floral hair pins woven with silver and gold-tone copper wire, faux South Sea pearls, and light-catching Austrian crystals. Flexible branches can be styled into wedding buns, braids, or half-up hairstyles.
products.short_description: Set of 6 flexible pearl and crystal wedding hair pins.
products.materials_and_finish: Pliable copper wire with acrylic pearls and crystal glass beads.
products.care_instructions: Do not spray hairspray directly on the pins.
